gitCommit.subject: feat(console): business summary and tabs, proof review beside the decision, proofs viewed in place; 0137 store wording; "boutique" in French
gitCommit.body:
feat(console): business summary and tabs, proof review beside the decision, proofs viewed in place; 0137 store wording; "boutique" in French

Owner, 2026-11-12 (layout review, approved direction; not yet published):
- One business: a summary (state, Store ID, paid until, stores, monthly total, the
  one next action) and five tabs - Stores, Payments, People, Messages & history,
  Settings. Access decisions with the payments; status decisions in Settings;
  deleting the business in its own danger zone.
- Payment review: one proof per full-width card, the proof beside the decision
  (on top of it on a phone), the latest revision named first, Approve primary,
  Refuse secondary; the stale-revision refusal kept.
- Payments tab: every proof of the business - approved and refused included -
  viewed in place on request, read-only, Download apart (GET
  platform/payment-proofs?company=).
- 0137 wording: an additional store opens when its own payment is confirmed,
  with its own paid month and no trial; a seat paid during the trial still starts
  at its end.
- French: "boutique" for a customer's store in the portal, console and public
  site, with articles and agreements; legal pages left for their own review.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
